messages:
maria: I'm about to land a PR to migrate the getting-started tutorial to SDK6. Main changes: auth env var name, new import/init shape, and a small tweak to the deploy CLI flags. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123. Planning to merge tomorrow EOD if CI is green — need a quick review on snippets + deploy steps.

kevin: on it, will check snippets and auth section. Can you paste the minimal python and node examples here so I can run them locally quickly?

maria: sure — pulled from the draft branch: 
```python
# python example (SDK6)
import os
from redwood_sdk import Client

client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY_V2'])
resp = client.generate('Hello from SDK6')
print(resp.text)
```

```javascript
// node example (SDK6)
import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood-sdk'
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY_V2 })
const resp = await client.generate('Hello from SDK6')
console.log(resp.text)
```

sean: quick note — SDK6 streaming behaves slightly differently (stream() yields chunk objects). We should show both blocking and streaming examples in the quickstart. Also the HTTP cURL example should use the header name `X-Redwood-Key` now (we changed the header to be explicit). I'll add a tiny streaming snippet to the PR.

frankie: CI is failing on docs-lint in the PR branch: 
```
docs-lint ERROR: code-block without language at docs/getting-started.md:87
```
I'm going to add language tags to all fenced blocks.

maria: thanks @frankie — already pushed a commit to add the tags and a short migration note at the top of the page: "If you used SDK <=5, replace REDWOOD_API_KEY with REDWOOD_API_KEY_V2 and update import path to 'redwood-sdk'."

kevin: :eyes: I ran the node example and hit a tiny typo — your draft used `new Redwood` in one spot; should be `new RedwoodClient`. Happy to open a quick PR to fix if you want.

maria: fixed and force-pushed. Rebased on main and CI kicked off again. There was one transient failure in the deploy smoke test (timeout to sandbox on macos runner). ci-bot, can you rerun the docs CI?

ci-bot: Re-run requested by maria — workflow docs-ci #512 restarted.

sean: :thumbsup: I'll sanity-check the deploy docs and smoke tests tomorrow AM. If CI is green I can merge the PR and add a short follow-up note for Dedicated/Dedicated+VPC users about pinning runtime flags.

maria: awesome, thanks everyone — goal is a small, focused change set so users upgrade smoothly. I'll post a short release note when it's merged.
